-----------------------------------------------
REFUND RULES APPLY PER FARE
COMPONENT.
-----------------------------------------------
WHEN COMBINING NON-REFUNDABLE
FARES WITH
REFUNDABLE FARES-
1. THE AMOUNT PAID ON EACH
REFUNDABLE FARE
COMPONENT IS REFUNDED.
2. THE AMOUNT PAID ON EACH NON-
REFUNDABLE FARE
COMPONENT WILL NOT BE REFUNDED.
3. WHEN COMBINING FARES CHARGE
THE SUM OF THE
CANCELLATION PENALTIES OF ALL
CANCELLED FARE
COMPONENTS.
-----------------------------------------------
REFUND FOR PARTLY USED TICKET- IF A
RETURN TICKET SHALL BE USED FOR
ONE WAY TRAVEL-
THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE RETURN
FARE AND THE APPLICABLE ONE WAY
FARE WILL/SHALL BE CALCULATED.
APPLICABLE ONE WAY IS THE ONE WAY
WITHIN THE SAME OR HIGHER
RBD/BRAND. ANY CREDIT WILL BE
REFUNDED LESS ANY APPLICABLE
CANCELLATION PENALTY.

VALIDITY.

ANY ORIGINAL NON-REFUNDABLE
